import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
export declare class Image extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        src: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        alt: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        width: {
            type: NumberConstructor;
        };
        height: {
            type: NumberConstructor;
        };
        srcset: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        sizes: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        loading: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        decorative: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        caption: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        descriptionId: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        status: {
            state: boolean;
        };
    };
    src: string;
    alt: string;
    width: number | undefined;
    height: number | undefined;
    srcset: string | undefined;
    sizes: string | undefined;
    loading: 'eager' | 'lazy';
    decorative: boolean;
    caption: string;
    descriptionId: string;
    private status;
    private descriptionObserver?;
    connectedCallback(): void;
    disconnectedCallback(): void;
    constructor();
    updated(): void;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
